note: Example data: an invented online booking software company with invented accounts, not a real business. Every number in expected_output.json follows from this input. The survey export holds the three questions the report uses; the GA4 property tracks the web app only.
request: Hey Claude, I just added the "product-market-fit-assessment" skill. Here is our product-market fit survey export. Do we have product-market fit, and who should we focus on?

product.name: Example Booking Software
product.one_line: online booking, reminders and payments for salons, clinics, studios and personal trainers
product.for: owners and front-desk managers of small service businesses with 1 to 20 staff, mostly in the US, UK and Canada

survey.source: Google Sheets (Google Forms responses), read with get_sheet_peak and query_sheet_data
survey.usage_rule: took at least 2 bookings in the 14 days before answering (column bookings_last_14d)
export_csv: response_id,user_id,submitted_at,business_type,team_size,bookings_last_14d,q1_without_product,q2_main_benefit,q5_what_to_improve
